verdict.rationale: Ashby's own AI agent, Ashby Assistant, is documented as able to "draft emails" from within the platform with access to recruiting context. That is a thin, first-party match to part of this story. missing for 10: AI-generated job descriptions, AI-drafted outreach sequences, rejection-note generation, matching the recruiter's personal tone, explicit drafting from the role's context, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context

citations.quote: Analyze pipelines, update candidates, draft emails, and more, with custom agents for repeated workflows.
Today, we're releasing Ashby Assistant, a chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language
